name: @tba3/module-base
description: Base classes for titled content modules as light-DOM Lit custom elements: lifecycle, content pass, visibility, resource cleanup and a card shell. Three runtime dependencies: Lit, whose ReactiveElement is the module base and whose templates render the modules, Floating UI (@floating-ui/dom), which keeps an open menu or popup at its anchor (`followAnchor`), and @preact/signals-core, the signals module state is kept in.
